subject: A stylised anatomical knee from a low three-quarter angle against a near-black field, the strap seated below the kneecap taking the load. Exactly as in the start frame.

camera.movement: Completely locked off: no drift, no orbit, no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no cut — one continuous shot from one fixed viewpoint.
camera.framing: Exactly as in the start frame, first frame to last.

motion: Already cycling on the first frame: a small load pulse arrives down the thigh once per second — the femur presses down a few millimetres onto the knee and releases, the muscles thicken slightly on each press and relax between. The strap meets each press first: its rigid shell holds still and the knit band stretches a fraction and eases back. Beneath it the tendon barely moves and the faint warmth at the spot below the kneecap stays dim. The product keeps the exact geometry of the start frame on every frame: same silhouette, same shell shape, same two matching peaks of equal height, same notch depth and width, same band width, same hardware position, same wordmark position and spelling. The rigid shell never bends, flexes, stretches, tapers or changes proportion under any movement or from any camera angle. Only the band's own elastic stretch is permitted, and it returns to its resting form. The last frame returns exactly to the start frame. Nothing else moves.
lighting: As in the start frame: three-source render lighting, near-black field, no change across the clip.
